Should he deal with our sister as with a harlot?— On this outrage alone they vindicated their flagitious conduct. The word harlot first occurs here: the original is not pilegesh, which we render concubine, (see its explanation Genesis 22:24) but zonah, which ordinarily signifies one who prostitutes herself to any person for hire.
